quarterly_data.quarter: WUS Printed Circuit IR activity record: 2026-1015-040 (10-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): per the company's published 9M 2026 results pre-announcement, revenue and net profit for the first three quarters of 2026 are both expected to grow quickly year over year, on structural demand from high-speed switches, AI servers, high-performance computing and smart vehicles plus a continuously optimized product mix; 9M 2026 net profit is expected at RMB 54.5-57 hundred million, up 100.54%-109.74% year over year. The Thailand subsidiary has moved from capacity ramp-up into scaled operation and turned profitable for the first three quarters of 2026.

quarterly_data.quarter: WUS Printed Circuit IR activity record: 2026-1015-040 (10-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record), on supply-chain security: at the front end the company gets involved at a very early stage of end customers' R&D, taking part in new-material performance validation and testing in advance to shorten certification cycles and lock in priority allocations; at the back end it holds strategic safety stock of key materials and is accelerating diversified and localized qualification to reduce supply-disruption risk.
